name: STAC Processing Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC Processing extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Processing extension (processing:expression, processing:lineage, processing:level, processing:facility, processing:datetime, processing:version and processing:software), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC Processing schema. Reuses STAC core classes rather than redefining them.
